title: tc-tips-panel
description: A panel of short tips, each with one action that marks it done.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

tips.description: The tips, in order – each with a title, a short description and one action

done.description: Ids of the tips whose action was taken

closable.description: Shows the Close button in the footer

description.description: Short explanation – text, or a node (cloned) that may hold <kbd class="ui-tp__kbd"> keys

doneLabel.description: Text after the action was taken, e.g. "Enabled"

primary.description: Shows the action as the dark button – use once for the most important tip
